methods.label: Subtracting one right angle
methods.explanation: A straight angle is 180 degrees. A straight angle contains 2 right angles. Each right angle measures 90 degrees, so taking away one right angle leaves the other: \(180 - 90 = 90\).
methods.levelReason: Subtracting multiples of ten and using straight and right angles are within Grade 4.
